profile.headline: Software Engineer - DevOps | Cloud | TypeScript | React | Node.js | AI
profile.summary:
Hello! I create applications with JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Redux, and Node.js/Express. I also build web applications to help clients meet their digital marketing and other business related goals.

A recent endeavor of mine is leading the front-end portion of a database version control tool that simplifies schema migrations for more efficient deployment.

I have too many hobbies, but the one at the forefront of my brain as of late, is Jiu Jitsu.

WIP: http://dittodevtool.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/syjeffkim

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Transitioned a restrictive no-code platform into a customizable backend framework on Google Cloud Run, enabling advanced logic, greater control, and reducing environment migration errors while improving deployment efficiency by 50%.
- Strengthened a webform email system by introducing multiple security layers—including CAPTCHA, honeypotting, and IP blocking— and engineering an automated cleanup script that eliminated spam vulnerabilities and ensured 100% inbox integrity post-deployment.
- Developed an AI chatbot on Google Cloud leveraging Dialogflow CX, integrating structured knowledge bases and advanced flow design to improve resolution times and overall customer satisfaction.
- Designed and implemented a backend data pipeline to ingest and process data into Google BigQuery, enabling automated analytics and reducing manual data handling.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Dialogflow CX · Prompt Engineering · Generative AI · Webhooks · Kanban · CCAIP · Twilio · RingCentral · JavaScript · TypeScript · NodeJs · Call Center as a Service · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Amazon S3 · Amazon Lex · Amazon Bedrock · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon CloudFront · Amazon Athena · Amazon CloudWatch

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
An open-source web browser application that enables developer teams to utilize version control for their schema migrations.
- Fine-tuned SEO by configuring Webpack and React Helmet to give an overall 92% rating on LightHouse.
- Utilized React with Typescript to create the Database Migration Management Dashboard, creating a developer centric UI/UX to monitor Postgres v14+ migrations and updates.
- Implemented React-Router, Redux and Redux-Persist to design Ditto’s User to Project to Databases State System in order for secure rehydration, state management and  navigation.
- Developed the Access Code Sharing Feature utilizing Node.js v20, Typescript, and Express, creating secure and shareable code to streamline engineering team management.
- Remodeled backend logic with Express to create an architecture that was efficient for API route handling, reducing server-side boilerplate. 
- Equipped with Bcrypt, JWT authentication, RBAC as well as providing GitHub OAuth to be SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliant and uphold quality standards for security so teams feel assured their data is safe.
- Hosted the internal database on Amazon RDS for the high availability, security, and reliability in a cloud environment which was essential for maintaining the performance of Ditto’s version control system.
- Tested with Jest for unit testing React components, leveraging the powerful mocking and assertion libraries to ensure reliable and thorough testing allowing the app to have over 80% test coverage swiftly.
- Constructed a database with PostgreSQL for the strong ACID compliance. PostgreSQL's indexing and powerful joins ensure reliability and rapid data retrieval; perfect to hold user, project and database information.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · Express.js · TypeScript · Jest · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front End | Date Night - Web and Mobile AI Evening Date Generator
- Employed React Router to create a single page application experience for simplicity and performance, crucial for an app designed to help couples find impromptu, yet tailored date suggestions quickly.
- Dispatched OpenAI’s advanced natural language processing capabilities and control to format data accordingly and give user’s unique suggestions.

Full Stack | Time Together - Web App To Find Free Time With Friends
- Constructed with TailwindCSS to design the Client Login and Sign Up Portal which streamlined development and built an aesthetically pleasing user interface/experience.
- Collaborated with project management to organize planning of the front-end team’s responsibilities to upheld agile development principles.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Jest · React Hooks · OpenAI Products · React Native

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Deployed customer facing applications on Netlify for the SSL certification and simplified incorporation of GitHub that allowed for continuous integration/continuous deployment as well as the easy to configure custom domain names.
- Drafted with Figma to visually communicate with clients their specific product requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Web Developer · Netlify · Domain Name System (DNS) · Tailwind CSS · User Experience (UX) · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Human Resources Manager
positions.description:
- Led end-to-end recruitment processes and successfully implemented comprehensive training plans, resulting in a 16% decrease time till significant internal promotions for employees.
- Designed cleared employee protocols per position, leading to 50% increase in length of employee tenure
- Fostered positive employee relations through effective communication and conflict resolution.
- Revamped and optimized the onboarding procedures, resulting in a 30% reduction in employee onboarding duration and a general consensus of boost in employee satisfaction.
- Managed ADP payroll, ensuring accurate and timely processing of payroll transactions.
- Implemented and executed marketing strategies to enhance the employer brand and attract top talent.
- Conducted employee onboarding and orientation sessions to facilitate seamless integration into the company culture.
- Provided support in creating and maintaining HR policies and procedures.
- Provided information about health benefits packages, FMLA, CRFA, and employment laws.
